payload.title: surplus positionals are ignored
payload.body: A domain verb reads its first positional as its subject and silently ignores any further positional, so 'design define eps --gloss e foo' writes eps and drops foo. The same fail-fast reasoning as verb flags applies to a verb's arity, but it is a different concept (how many arguments a verb takes), not a flag.
